name: Shanghai New World Co., Ltd
summary: Shanghai New World Co., Ltd. owns and operates department stores in China. The company produce and distributes Chinese herbal medicines; and sells Chinese patent medicines, western medicines, ginseng and antler tonics, and nutritional health products. It also involved in hotel, investment consulting and management, property and project management, advertising, dining, entertainment, e-commerce, clothing, trading, tourism, leisure, and retail pharmaceutical businesses, as well as provides Chinese herbal medicine consultation and prescription services. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
